title: App Store & Google Play Reviews input

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: App Store or Google Play URLs, or IDs. The store is detected automatically: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/spotify-music-and-podcasts/id324684580, id324684580 or 324684580 = App Store; https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spotify.music or com.spotify.music = Google Play. Prefix with apple: to use an iOS bundle ID (apple:com.spotify.client).

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code of the store (us, gb, de, fr, jp, br, in, ...). App Store reviews are per country; Google Play reviews are filtered by it.

language.title: Language (Google Play)
language.description: Two-letter language code (en, de, es, pt, ja, ...). Google Play returns reviews written in this language. The App Store has no language filter.

sort.title: Sort by
sort.description: Newest first, or the store's "most relevant" / "most helpful" order.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Stop after this many reviews for each app. Each review is billed as one event.

sinceDate.title: Only reviews since
sinceDate.description: Only reviews posted on or after this date: YYYY-MM-DD, or relative like "7 days" or "1 month". With sort = Newest, scraping stops as soon as older reviews are reached, so scheduled runs only pay for new reviews.

onlyNew.title: Only new reviews (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only reviews not returned by an earlier run with the same apps, country, language and rating filter. Schedule the actor daily for new-review alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new reviews. Forces sort = Newest. State is kept in the key-value store "app-store-reviews-state" in your account.

minRating.title: Min rating
minRating.description: Only reviews with at least this many stars (1-5).

maxRating.title: Max rating
maxRating.description: Only reviews with at most this many stars (1-5). Set to 2 to collect complaints only.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Not needed for normal volumes; use Apify Proxy for very large runs if the stores start rate-limiting.
